panels.title: Pending alerts (approx)
panels.description: Approximation: emitted − sent. Exact: SELECT count(*) FROM polymarket_alerts WHERE status='pending'.

panels.title: Postgres trades (total)
panels.description: Proxy: cumulative ingest counters across all markets.

panels.title: Signal quality · directional correctness (24h rolling rate)
panels.description: Resolved-alert success rate over the last 24h, computed from watchtower_alert_outcomes_total. Bias-aware: pending and unavailable outcomes are excluded from the denominator. Read as 'of alerts whose markets have resolved in the last 24h, what fraction were directionally correct?'

panels.title: Signal quality · resolved vs pending (count / 1h)
panels.description: Stacked counts of new outcome verdicts per hour. Pending = market hasn't resolved yet; ambiguous = winning price never cleared the threshold; unavailable = market not in upstream snapshot.

panels.title: Signal quality by severity (24h success rate)
panels.description: Per-severity directional-correctness rate. Sample sizes are usually small at Critical/Hard; treat as directional, not statistically stable.

panels.title: Signal quality by alert kind (24h success rate)
panels.description: Per-alert-kind directional-correctness rate. trade_anomaly vs accumulation vs category_watch vs ownership_concentration.

panels.title: Telegram outcome reactions (rate / 15m)
panels.description: setMessageReaction results. 'unsupported' = Telegram refused (channel doesn't allow reactions, bot has no rights, paid reaction needed); 'failed' = retryable transport error.

panels.title: Signal reports sent (24h)
panels.description: Scheduled signal-quality reports successfully delivered to Telegram in the last 24h.

panels.title: Signal reports failed (24h)
panels.description: Scheduled reports that failed to send. Non-zero usually means Telegram chat misconfigured or upstream rate-limit.

panels.title: PAL · cumulative realized edge
panels.description: Cumulative sum of (success_binary − implied_probability_at_alert) over resolved alerts. A green line that trends UP is the proof-of-value signal: our alerts on average beat what the market itself priced. A flat or descending line means alerts are not adding value over the market's own probability.

panels.title: PAL · avg realized edge by severity (24h rolling)
panels.description: Average edge per resolved alert, broken down by severity. Critical/Hard should out-edge Info if the severity ladder is meaningful.

panels.title: PAL · avg realized edge by alert kind (24h rolling)
panels.description: Edge per kind: trade_anomaly vs accumulation vs category_watch vs ownership_concentration. If one kind contributes most of the positive edge, weight your operator attention there.

panels.title: PAL · weighted success rate (24h rolling)
panels.description: Severity-weighted success rate: sum(weight × success) / sum(weight). Weights: Info=1 Warning=3 Critical=10 Hard=25. A flat rate while raw Info volume rises means we're adding noise without adding edge.

panels.title: PAL · calibration by implied-probability bucket (24h)
panels.description: For each implied-probability bucket, the share of resolved alerts that turned out correct. The market thinks the 10-20% bucket should win 10-20% of the time; if it wins MORE than that, we have signal in the long-shot region. The most informative buckets are 0-10 / 10-20 / 20-30.

panels.title: PAL · CLV-lite avg favourable drift
panels.description: Average post-trade price drift in the alert's direction over four reference windows. A positive curve at 15m → 6h means the market moved our way after the alert fired — informative even before final resolution.

panels.title: PAL · resolved sample size (7d)
panels.description: Count of resolved alerts in the last 7 days. Below 30 the dashboard numbers are dominated by noise — treat as directional only. The PAL doc gives binomial CIs.

panels.title: PAL · pending outcomes (count)
panels.description: Alerts whose market hasn't resolved yet. A pile of pending means the dashboard is lagging — the latest week of alerts is invisible to the edge calculation. Wait for resolution before re-tuning.

panels.title: Prediction evolution runs (rate / 15m)
panels.description: Per-status outcomes of the evolution worker. A persistent climb on failed indicates the deterministic refresh is broken — the AI gating layer should still skip on failure.

panels.title: Prediction creation runs (rate / 30m)
panels.description: Per-status outcomes of the creation worker. ok = full cycle; daily_cap_reached = per-day cap hit; no_picks = AI ranker returned nothing.

panels.title: Prediction state transitions (rate / 15m)
panels.description: Deterministic state-machine transitions emitted by the evolution worker, labelled by from→to. Heatmap of the alerting health of the prediction layer.

panels.title: Prediction AI skipped reasons (rate / 1h)
panels.description: Why the AI thesis-refresh was skipped. budget_denied / cooldown_active / state_unchanged are healthy; failed = needs operator look.

panels.title: Repricing signals (rate / 15m)
panels.description: Deterministic repricing classifier output by status + flow timing. underreacting / overreacting are actionable; unclear dominating means CurrentPrice is missing (parser bug? event-page broken?).

panels.title: Catalyst upserts by type (rate / 1h)
panels.description: AI-extracted catalyst rows persisted by status × type. A drop on expected/runoff/election_day means the importer is failing for political markets.

panels.title: Blocked-alert annotations attached (24h)
panels.description: Count of Telegram alerts where a catalyst-driven Blocked block was attached. Low = catalyst importer isn't finding relevant catalysts.

panels.title: Event-page annotations / 1h
panels.description: Annotation ingest rate from polymarket.com event pages. Drops to zero = build_id rotated, parser failed, or polymarket changed shape.

panels.title: Event-page parse failures by field (rate / 15m)
panels.description: Per-field type-drift counter. A sustained climb on a specific JSON path means Polymarket changed encoding upstream and the tolerant parser took the fallback. Investigate the field.

panels.title: Event-page market parse skipped (24h)
panels.description: Count of markets the parser dropped because their JSON was structurally broken. Non-zero = repricing for those markets is dead.

panels.title: AI budget spend by bucket (USD, today)
panels.description: Live per-bucket AI spend today (resets at UTC midnight). When a bucket flatlines under its cap, AI denials should be ZERO for that bucket; look at the denials panel if not.

panels.title: AI budget global spend (USD, today)
panels.description: Cumulative AI spend today across every bucket. Compares against AI_GLOBAL_DAILY_BUDGET_USD.

panels.title: AI budget denials (rate / 1h)
panels.description: AI calls denied by the budget governor, labelled by bucket + reason. bucket_exhausted = bucket cap hit; global_exhausted = global cap hit. A persistent denial on the alert_analysis bucket means the cap is too tight for production.

panels.title: Predictions created (24h)
panels.description: Predictions inserted by the creation worker in the last 24h. 0 = workflow broken OR daily cap reached.

panels.title: Predictions evolved (1h)
panels.description: Predictions touched by the evolution worker in the last hour. The worker stamps every processed row even when nothing changed, so 0 = worker is not running.

panels.title: Prediction decay applications (24h)
panels.description: Confidence-decay applications. Healthy when the watchtower is observing many quiet predictions; alarmingly high means the deterministic state machine isn't catching meaningful changes.

panels.title: Outcome mapping unknowns by reason (rate / 1h)
panels.description: Reasons the v10.2 outcome mapper failed to resolve (unknown_condition_id | unknown_token_id | label_not_found | …). A persistent climb on any one reason is operator-actionable.

panels.title: Repricing status mix (rate / 15m)
panels.description: Deterministic repricing classifier output by status. Once v10.2 outcome mapping is live, the share of "unclear" should drop substantially in favour of underreacting / already_priced / reversed / stale_annotation.

panels.title: Top active predictions by usefulness
panels.description: Live operator-ranked top-10 actionable predictions. Backed by polymarket_prediction_usefulness_scores; refreshed every evolution cycle. Use the score column to triage attention.

panels.title: Blocked predictions
panels.description: Count of predictions currently in state=blocked. After v10.2 revalidation, this should NOT grow without bound — predictions whose expected_at passed >24h ago revalidate out of blocked.

panels.title: Confirmed by flow (24h)
panels.description: Predictions whose state flipped to confirmed_by_flow in the last 24h.

panels.title: Contradicted by flow (24h)
panels.description: Predictions whose state flipped to contradicted_by_flow in the last 24h.

panels.title: Stale predictions (24h flip)
panels.description: Predictions whose state flipped to stale in the last 24h. Sustained growth = the v10.2 catalyst stale-after (72h) may be too short for some markets.

panels.title: Underreacting markets (rate / 15m)
panels.description: Repricing classifier status=underreacting rate — the operator-actionable "price hasn't caught up yet" surface.

panels.title: Already-priced + stale_annotation (rate / 15m)
panels.description: Repricing classifier outputs we treat as "edge gone". Useful to see how quickly fresh signals decay.

panels.title: Catalyst upserts by type (rate / 1h)
panels.description: Catalyst importer write rate per catalyst_type. Identifies which event types drive the most blocked predictions.

panels.title: Prediction feedback by horizon (rate / 1h)
panels.description: Feedback rows written per horizon (1h / 6h / 24h). The 24h line is the load-bearing calibration signal — direction_correct rate over time tells us whether the prediction engine adds value.

panels.title: AI budget by surface (USD, today)
panels.description: Per-surface AI spend gauge. Watch for budget exhaustion (flatline) and rebalance bucket caps as needed.

panels.title: Telegram sends/skips by reason (rate / 1h)
panels.description: Prediction-creation Telegram outcomes. "sent" is the actionable surface; "skipped" is the protection layer.

panels.title: Worker cycle duration (p95) by worker
panels.description: Per-worker tick wall-clock latency. Compare to the worker's Interval — when latency approaches Interval, the next Ticker fire will be skipped by the overlap guard.

panels.title: Worker overlap skips (rate / 1h)
panels.description: Ticks the overlap guard skipped because the previous tick was still running. Persistent non-zero = the worker is consistently slower than its Interval.

panels.title: AI prompt chars distribution by surface
panels.description: Per-surface compacted prompt size. Drift past the configured cap means the v10.3 compactor is firing; chart against ai_compactions_total.

panels.title: AI compactions / skips by surface (rate / 1h)
panels.description: How often each AI surface had its prompt compacted vs entirely skipped over-cap. A spike on chars_cap skips = caps may be too tight.

panels.title: Prediction evaluations by class (rate / 24h)
panels.description: v10.3 deterministic classifier output across horizons. Watch the wrong_direction line: a persistent climb means the prediction engine is mis-calibrated.

panels.title: Prediction evaluations by horizon (rate / 24h)
panels.description: Split of evaluations across 1h/6h/24h. Healthy: 1h-heavy early, 24h takes over after 24h of runtime.

panels.title: Predictions archived (24h)
panels.description: v10.3 archival worker. Healthy when terminal predictions are being retired regularly.

panels.title: Predictions staled (24h)
panels.description: v10.3 stale-no-signal sweep. Predictions the archival worker flipped to state=stale.

panels.title: Wrong-direction predictions (7d)
panels.description: The load-bearing failure class. Persistent climb = calibration issue.

panels.title: Useful_correct + useful_early (7d)
panels.description: Positive evaluation outcomes — what we want to see climbing.

panels.title: AI surface estimated vs charged cost (USD, today)
panels.description: Estimated cost (preflight) vs. charged cost (actual). A growing gap means our per-call estimate is wrong; recalibrate the surface's EstCostUSD.

panels.title: Outcome mapping success vs unknown (rate / 1h)
panels.description: The v10.2 outcome mapper. A growing share of unknowns = parser drift or new outcome shapes; check the unknown breakdown panel.

panels.title: Repricing status distribution (v10.3 healthy mix)
panels.description: After v10.2 outcome-mapping wiring, the 'unclear' share should drop. Persistent unclear-dominance = mapper failing or stale annotations.

panels.title: Telegram sends/skips by reason (v10.3 verified)
panels.description: Total sent vs skipped (with reason). The v10.3 audit verified every surface is gated; persistent startup_suppressed or cooldown shows the guards firing.

panels.title: WS connected
panels.description: 1 when the Polymarket CLOB WS client is connected, 0 otherwise.

panels.title: WS reconnects (24h)
panels.description: Reconnect attempts. Steady non-zero = backoff is working as designed.

panels.title: WS subscriptions
panels.description: Current count of subscribed CLOB token ids.

panels.title: Buffer depth
panels.description: Current depth of the WS output channel. Sustained climb = the worker can't keep up with the stream.

panels.title: Last event age (s)
panels.description: Seconds since the last inbound WS message. Above WS_HEALTH_STALE_AFTER = degraded.

panels.title: Decode errors (24h)
panels.description: Total inbound messages the decoder couldn't parse.

panels.title: WS events by type (rate / 5m)
panels.description: book / price_change / last_trade_price / best_bid_ask / tick_size_change / market_resolved / heartbeat / unknown.

panels.title: WS drops by reason (rate / 5m)
panels.description: Events dropped by the bounded output channel. Persistent buffer_full = increase WS_EVENT_BUFFER or reduce subscription scope.

panels.title: Realtime work enqueued by reason (rate / 5m)
panels.description: price_move / book_change / trade_seen / market_status / gap_recovered. price_move ⇒ repricing refresh trigger; book_change ⇒ prediction refresh.

panels.title: Gap recoveries by status (rate / 1h)
panels.description: Reconciliation sweep outcomes (ok / no_trades / partial / failed).

panels.title: Reconcile duration (p95)
panels.description: End-to-end duration of one reconciliation sweep.

panels.title: Subscription refresh outcomes (rate / 1h)
panels.description: ok | unchanged | failed per WS_SUBSCRIPTION_REFRESH_EVERY cycle.

panels.title: WS vs polling — realtime work claimed (rate / 1h)
panels.description: Work-queue claim rate by reason + status. Used to compare "WS-triggered work" vs polling's own pipeline.
